mapper.select: SELECT reservation_id , fair_id , user_id , visit_date , reservation_type , status FROM reservations WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation_histories ( reservation_id , action_type , before_data , after_data , changed_by , actor_type , is_admin_action , change_reason , created_at ) VALUES ( #{reservationId} , 'VISIT_DATE_CHANGED' , JSON_OBJECT('visitDate', #{previousVisitDate}) , JSON_OBJECT('visitDate', #{visitDate}) , #{changedBy} , 'USER' , FALSE , NULL , #{now} )
